dec.n: Union Inter-Africaine des Droits de l’Homme v. Angola
dec.ct: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights
dec.pe: Angola arrested and expelled hundreds of people from West Africa, many working in diamond areas, without any court process. The African Commission said mass expulsion is forbidden.
dec.pi: Angola menangkap dan mengusir ratusan orang dari Afrika Barat, banyak yang bekerja di kawasan berlian, tanpa proses pengadilan. Komisi Afrika menyatakan pengusiran massal dilarang.

dec.ct: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights
dec.pe: A Gambian man working in Angola was arrested in a large sweep, held in bad conditions and expelled without a hearing. The African Commission found Angola breached the Charter.
dec.pi: Seorang pria Gambia yang bekerja di Angola ditangkap dalam razia besar, ditahan dalam kondisi buruk, dan diusir tanpa sidang. Komisi Afrika menyatakan Angola melanggar Piagam.
